description.value: Reckless Bike Stores is a well-established Vancouver-area multi-location bike retailer in the Kitsilano neighbourhood, carrying a broad range of bikes including eBikes, cargo, folding, and drop-bar models alongside cycling accessories. The shop runs a dedicated service department for both conventional bikes and eBikes, including an authorised Rad Power Bikes service centre. Touring cyclists will find it a solid resource for rentals, accessories such as pannier bags, and mechanical support.

address.value: 1810 Fir St, Vancouver, BC V6J 3B1, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Reckless Bikes (reckless.ca) is an active multi-location Vancouver bike retailer and service shop. The navigation menus reveal a dedicated 'Service' section covering 'Bikes and eBikes' and a standalone 'Rad Power Bikes Service' subpage, confirming bike repair capabilities and e-bike service. Bike rentals are confirmed via 'Performance Road Rentals' and 'City Rentals & eBike Rentals' menu items; pannier bags appear in the accessories navigation, indicating touring-relevant parts. Website content was largely consumed by the currency-selector widget, leaving most amenity detail unverifiable.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, established bike shop with confirmed service department and rentals in the Kitsilano neighbourhood of Vancouver — clearly useful to touring cyclists.
